subject: Matemática e suas Tecnologias
description_pt: Resolver e elaborar problemas, em diferentes contextos, que envolvem cálculo e interpretação das medidas de tendência central (média, moda, mediana) e das medidas de dispersão (amplitude, variância e desvio padrão).

components.description_pt: Resumir conjuntos de dados numéricos em relação ao seu contexto calculando medidas quantitativas de tendência central
components.description_en: Summarize numerical data sets in relation to their context by calculating quantitative measures of center (median and/or mean)
components.cc_component_description: Summarize numerical data sets in relation to their context by calculating quantitative measures of center (median and/or mean)

components.description_pt: Calcular amplitude, variância e desvio padrão para um conjunto de dados dado
components.description_en: Calculate range, variance, and standard deviation for a given data set
components.cc_component_description: Summarize numerical data sets in relation to their context by calculating quantitative measures of variability (interquartile range and/or mean absolute deviation)

components.description_pt: Interpretar diferenças em diferentes conjuntos de dados no contexto, incluindo diferenças devido a possíveis efeitos de outliers
components.description_en: Interpret differences in different data sets in context, including differences due to possible effects of outliers
components.cc_component_description: Interpret differences in different data sets in context, including differences due to possible effects of outliers

components.description_pt: Resolver problemas envolvendo medidas de tendência central e dispersão em contextos reais
components.description_en: Solve problems involving measures of central tendency and dispersion in real-world contexts
components.cc_component_description: Analyze and evaluate strategies in real world contexts using probability concepts

cc_matches.description: *Summarize numerical data sets in relation to their context, such as by* giving quantitative measures of center (median and/or mean) and variability (interquartile range and/or mean absolute deviation), as well as describing any overall pattern and any striking deviations from the overall pattern with reference to the context in which the data were gathered.
Interpret differences in shape, center, and spread in the context of the data sets, accounting for possible effects of extreme data points (outliers).
(+) Analyze decisions and strategies using probability concepts (e.g., product testing, medical testing, pulling a hockey goalie at the end of a game).

prerequisites.description_pt: Planejar e coletar dados de pesquisa referente a práticas sociais escolhidas pelos alunos e fazer uso de planilhas eletrônicas para registro, representação e interpretação das informações, em tabelas, vários tipos de gráficos e texto.
